question: Looking down from the edge of a 20-meter high cliff, the angle to a boat on the water is 60° below the horizontal. What is the horizontal distance between the boat and the cliff's bottom?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

⇒ Angle of depression = 60° ⇒ use tan

⇒ tan 60° = Height ÷ Base = 20 ÷ x

⇒ √3 = 20/x

⇒ x = 20/√3

⇒ x = (20√3)/3

**∴ Answer = (20√3)/3 m**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height of cliff = 20 m

Angle of depression = 60°

**Formula Used:**

tan θ = Perpendicular ÷ Base

 
• 
• 
• 20 m x 60° 

**Calculation:**

⇒ tan 60° = 20 ÷ x

⇒ √3 = 20/x

⇒ x = 20/√3

⇒ x = (20√3)/3

**∴ Final Answer = (20√3)/3 m**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
